# Fortune India

> Fortune India is India's leading business and financial news platform covering markets, economy, corporate insights, technology, and lifestyle with in-depth analysis and exclusive features.

Fortune India delivers comprehensive coverage of Indian business, markets, and economy alongside global news, technology trends, and lifestyle content. The platform features flagship annual lists including Fortune 500 India, India's Best CEOs, and MNC 500, along with multimedia content including videos, shorts, and visual stories.

## Key Topics

- Indian Economy
- Stock Markets (Sensex, Nifty)
- Business News
- Corporate Leadership
- Startup Ecosystem
- Personal Finance
- Technology & AI
- RBI Policy
- Cryptocurrency
- Rupee & Forex
- Trade Agreements
- Energy Crisis
- Automobile Industry
- Real Estate & Lifestyle
- Fortune 500 India

## Core News & Markets

- [Fortune India Homepage](https://www.fortuneindia.com): Fortune India homepage with business news, finance, economy, and corporate insights
- [Business News](https://www.fortuneindia.com/business-news): Latest business news from India and worldwide covering markets and companies
- [Market News](https://www.fortuneindia.com/markets): Live stock market updates, Sensex, Nifty, and expert market analysis
- [India News](https://www.fortuneindia.com/india): Breaking news from India covering politics, economy, and financial markets
- [Economy](https://www.fortuneindia.com/economy): In-depth analysis on Indian economy including GDP, inflation, and RBI policy
- [World News](https://www.fortuneindia.com/world): Global headlines, geopolitics, and international business from worldwide regions

## Flagship Lists & Special Issues

- [India's Largest Companies](https://www.fortuneindia.com/magazine/indias-largest-companies-december-2025): Fortune 500 India annual list of largest companies and best B-schools
- [India's Best CEOs](https://www.fortuneindia.com/magazine/indias-best-ceos-november-2025): Annual Fortune India special issue celebrating India's best business leaders
- [India's Biggest Unicorns](https://www.fortuneindia.com/magazine/march-2026-indias-biggest-unicorns): Fortune India's listing of India's biggest unicorns and startup ecosystem
- [MNC 500: The Largest Multinationals in India](https://www.fortuneindia.com/magazine/february-2026-mnc-500-indias-largest-multinationals): MNC 500 list of largest multinationals in India and Budget 2026 analysis
- [Netflix's India Decade](https://www.fortuneindia.com/magazine/best-investments-2026-january-2026): Netflix India decade feature with Ted Sarandos interview and investment guide

## Finance & Personal Investing

- [Personal Finance News](https://www.fortuneindia.com/personal-finance): Personal finance tips, investing guides, budgeting, and financial planning

## Technology & Innovation

- [Technology News](https://www.fortuneindia.com/technology): Tech news on AI innovations, IT companies like NVIDIA and Adobe, product launches

## Sectors & Lifestyle

- [Auto News](https://www.fortuneindia.com/auto): Auto news, car/bike reviews, EV charging, and automotive industry updates
- [Business Lifestyle](https://www.fortuneindia.com/lifestyle): Business lifestyle, wealth trends, luxury, travel, fashion, and real estate

## Multimedia & Opinion

- [Business Videos & Insights](https://www.fortuneindia.com/videos): Video library with business insights, interviews, and leadership content
- [Fortune India Shorts](https://www.fortuneindia.com/short-videos): YouTube Shorts with rapid business insights on leaders, startups, and markets
- [Visual Stories](https://www.fortuneindia.com/visual-stories): Photo essays and visual narratives on business, technology, and lifestyle
- [Opinion](https://www.fortuneindia.com/opinion): Opinion articles on India business, AI, regulatory policy, and digital assets

## Optional

- [Creator of the Month](https://www.fortuneindia.com/creator-of-the-month): Monthly spotlight on Indian content creators and digital storytellers
